_meta.honesty: Every number below is measured. GATED = SimilarWeb returned no data (below threshold) — never fabricated.

verified_verdicts.mass_vs_designer_geo_asymmetry: UNSUPPORTED — SG/HK presence tracks brand HOME MARKET (HK/TW houses), not designer-vs-mass. KR/JP absent from every brand's top-6 geo. US = universal top diaspora market. VN designer+mass geo both gated → no VN comparison possible.
verified_verdicts.designer_social_more_than_mass: CONTRADICTED where data exists — Xéo Xọ (mass) 9.3% social > Phan Huy (designer) 6.5%.
verified_verdicts.pinterest_correlates_designer: PARTIAL — Pinterest nav-link skews to VN contact-price designers (Công Trí/Thuỷ/Phương My) vs 0/2 mass; BUT Phan Huy + Guo Pei (couture) have none; Sau Lee shows Pinterest=36% of social despite no captured link.
verified_verdicts.vietnamese_dress_designers_intent: INFORMATIONAL (research), NOT commercial 'find-a-designer'. Do not claim purchase intent.
verified_verdicts.niche_aodai_longtail_demand: ZERO everywhere (custom/bespoke/luxury/evening/beaded ao dai, hand embroidered silk gown, VN long-tail). Real demand = generic occasionwear.
verified_verdicts.congtri_phanhuy_offering: BOTH offer real bespoke/made-to-order (NOT RTW-only) + a separate RTW line; both contact-for-price. Phan Huy leans haute-couture/bespoke language; Công Trí frames MTO as personalization.

ZERO_everywhere: ao dai may do cao cap
keyword_demand_us_au_ca_ww_vn.notes: CN endpoint unsupported; SG/KR/HK all tested EN terms = 0 (may be no-data not true-zero).
